question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.

Joe was so tired that he could scarely stand.
solution:
The correct answer is ***Option 3)***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"scarely"** is a misspelling of the word "***scarcely,***" which means barely or hardly. (मुश्किल से)

 
 
• **Example:** He could ***scarcely*** believe his eyes when he saw the surprise party.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"scarcely"**, which means barely or only just. (मुश्किल से)
 
 
• **Example:** Joe was so tired that he could ***scarcely*** stand.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is ***Scarcely ***stand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: "he could"** (वह कर सकता था): This phrase is correctly spelled and grammatically correct.

 
 
• **Example:** He could easily solve the puzzle.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: "so tired that"** (इतना थका हुआ कि): This phrase is correctly spelled and grammatically correct.
 
 
• **Example:** She was so tired that she fell asleep immediately.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "Joe was"** (जो था): This phrase is correctly spelled and grammatically correct.
 
 
• **Example:** Joe was ready for the challenge.
